procedure: After human baseline selection only, compile each test source as a separate executable with common sources and one copy of shared sources. Run in an isolated local output directory. Do not compile OS/HAL translation units into host tests; qualify them separately using selected target SDK/cpo records. This JSON does not execute a compiler.
excluded_from_x86_host: ArmSmmu4KMmio.c is the AArch64 direct MMIO binding. Host state machines use supplied fake IO callbacks; do not disable its architecture guard.
shared_sources_relative_to_package_meani: historical names only; resolve basenames in exact component selected by integration/shared-component.json

actual native PIL helper and ADSP lifecycle; synthetic SCM checks query/stop order, once-only behavior and failed-stop DMA gating
real private input parser, no hardware
production C++ adapter; fake native and Assembly providers
real cold Assembly, private input and guarded host allocations; all hardware mutation callbacks abort
real two-family copy/BSS with host PAS/cache callbacks, guarded RAM, no device
actual native sync router with fake clean/barrier primitives; metadata/WC ownership and bounds
actual ADSP retention/handover state machine with synthetic shared state and proxy callbacks; no hardware
production GLINK/QRTR and fixed stock QMI bytes, exact queue/FIFO waits and terminal loss/overflow; synthetic peer, no hardware
production local OPEN path, passive synthetic peer and ordered transport link event; no device
reused production reset-muted identity sequencer, exact settling and failure cleanup; synthetic hardware only
Five production TAS endpoint cases with synthetic diagnostic/hardware time; no device
Production PCM/probe functions with synthetic CPU buffers; full two seconds after a silent first period, partial return, draining and no input publication
Actual fixed numeric observation/history implementation, duplicate/capacity and bounded copies; no phone
Actual board, SoundWire and WCD initialization with known2.0/real2.2 IDs; both binding gates share compatibility, unrecognized revision stops before reset/enumeration; modeled IO

Production board/WCD/graph/runtime with independent diagnostic and hardware time; unchanged046 negative control preserves original -5 while runtime reports -8; current first-error retention and five-second hardware/scheduler deadlines
Tagged accepted-output reference survives native consumption; clipping, late writes, wrap, silence and epoch; actual AudioRing.c under ASan/UBSan
Production HAL included directly; stock24A446 Speaker UID, last input tap UInt32, real MicReady gating, formats and accepted PCM ReadInput without a mic request

Production runtime/engine/graph/TAS with synthetic peers: silent running graph/PRM, repeated and rapid StopStart, staged discard, freshmap epoch/time origin, finite capture after output idle, real fault/disconnect and shutdown cleanup
production board/WCD/SoundWire clock ratios, exact bank switch command, both banks and bounded failed switch; synthetic IO
